sutta: automatically becomes an arahan 8.2 Duty that's how I heard at one time the Lord was staying near savati in the Jeter wood at anatap indica's Monastery on that occasion the Lord was instructing the monks with the Dharma talk connected with nibana and those monks were intent on listening to dhamma they're not realizing its significance the Lord uttered on that occasion this inspired utterance the uninclined is hard to see the truth is not easy to see grieving is benefited by one who knows for one who sees there is nothing this word uninclined from the word means incline and meaning craving toward this uninclined there's no craving it's Nirvana it's hard to see
